turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Hale. I have until 4:40, and my son found out about a zero on his phone, in the middle of class, before anyone called me. Who decided that, and on what basis?
Before we go on, I'm recording this meeting.
Fine, record it. Then it's on the record that you still haven't said who decided on the zero, and whether Owen was heard first.
And if you so much as mention legal action, I'm filing a harassment complaint through the union.
I haven't said a word about legal action, Hale. I'm writing down that a parent asking who entered a zero gets threatened with the union. Now, who decided?
I always do. Three questions now and no answers, so either you show me what this zero rests on, or I'm in the principal's office before my call.
